@: Zones editor: per-streamer detection zones drawn as boxes over a sample frame (web/js/zones.js). A zone is a screen area the detector reads; a template is one streamer's set of boxes; a version is a dated template.
@zone.ticker: The area of the game screen with the reward lines (the game's own words KILL, ASSIST, ... stay in English).
zone.ticker_tip: reward ticker (KILL +$1,500, ASSIST ...): the lines under the money readout
zone.money_tip: the money readout band at the top of the ticker; its bottom edge splits the readout from the ticker lines
zone.feed_tip: the kill feed (rows with the [60 m] distance tag)
@zone.center_tip: RESPAWNING is the game's own on-screen word: keep it in English.
zone.center_tip: where RESPAWNING shows (the death check reads this box)
@streamer.recs: Short: number of recordings in a narrow list.
streamers.none_help: Import a VOD first: its streamer shows up here.
check.money_inside: money: must lie inside the ticker box
check.feed_row: feed row: must be > 0 and no taller than the feed box
guard.title: Unsaved zone changes
guard.body_html: The boxes of {name} were changed and not saved.
title: Detection zones
new_tip: A new template for this streamer, starting from the built-in boxes
side_foot: Boxes are stored per streamer, dated: a recording uses the newest version that started before it.
redetect_tip: Queue detect again for every recording of this streamer (uses the SAVED zones)
ver_tip: Keep this version as it was saved and store these boxes as a NEW version from a date on (the stream layout changed)
name: Name
eff_tip: This version applies to recordings that START at / after this moment; empty = from the start (the earliest version also covers older recordings)
note_ph: e.g. new overlay since the 1.4 patch
rec_tip: The recording the sample frame is grabbed from
grab_tip: Grab the frame at that moment of that recording
sample_tip: Show the template's stored sample frame again
money_def_tip: Use the built-in band: the top 70/160 of the ticker
rowh_tip: One kill-feed row's height (the dashed lines in the feed box)
num_tip: The selected box in sample pixels (arrows nudge 1 px, shift 10 px)
@keys_html: Keep the ... parts (keyboard keys) as they are; translate the words between them.
keys_html: ←→ nudge 1 px, Shift 10 px · Ctrl S save · Esc close
toast.row_max: a feed row is at most the feed box's height ({px} px)
menu.reset_sub: the built-in Season 2 boxes for this frame size
menu.export_streamer_sub: this streamer's templates, with their sample frames
menu.import_sub: templates from a .json file exported here (or on another PC)
menu.export_all_sub: every template of every streamer, with their sample frames
menu.export_this_sub: its templates, with their sample frames
toast.wait_save: wait for the save to finish
toast.seeded: {streamer} has no template of its own: starting from {seed} - Save creates one for this streamer
rec.none: no probed recordings of this streamer
toast.pick_rec: pick a recording of this streamer first
frame.no_rec: No sample frame: this streamer has no probed recording yet. The boxes can still be set on this blank frame.
frame.pick_streamer: Pick a streamer on the left.
frame.tpl_missing: the template's sample frame is missing - grab a frame of a recording
frame.grab_failed: could not grab a frame at {time} of recording #{id} (file missing or past the end?)
box.label: {zone} {w}x{h}
num.none: Select a box to edit its position
@num.x: Short axis labels in front of the selected box's numbers: x = left edge, y = top edge, w = width, h = height (in pixels).
tpl.new_seed: new template, starting from {seed} (not saved yet)
tpl.new_seed_tip: a copy of {seed}'s boxes for this streamer; Save stores it as this streamer's own template (the other one is left as it is)
tpl.new_version_tip: starts from the built-in boxes; Save stores it
tpl.default_tip: no template for this streamer yet: detection uses the built-in boxes; Save stores these as its first template
pin.pin_tip: recording #{id} always uses this version, whatever its date
pin.pin_tip_unsaved: recording #{id} always uses this version, whatever its date (save it first)
pin.unpin_tip: recording #{id} goes back to its streamer's dated versions
@src.uses_tpl: {source} is one of the zones.source.* texts (how the version was chosen).
src.seed: editing a new template starting from {seed}
note.rec: frame: rec #{id} at {time} ({w}x{h}) - Save stores it as the sample
toast.required: the ticker and the kill feed boxes are required
toast.saved: zones saved - Re-detect applies them to recordings already scanned
toast.saved_nosample: zones saved - Re-detect applies them to recordings already scanned - sample frame NOT stored: {error}
toast.created_nosample: template created - sample frame NOT stored: {error}
toast.version_from_nosample: new version from {date} - sample frame NOT stored: {error}
toast.version_start_nosample: new version from the start - sample frame NOT stored: {error}
ver.title: Save as a new version
ver.hint_tpl: Recordings that start at / after this moment use the new version; older ones keep “{name}”.
ver.hint_none: Recordings that start at / after this moment use the new version; older ones keep the earlier versions.
ver.default_rec: Default: the start of the frame's recording (#{id}).
ver.default: Default: the start of the frame's recording.
ver.kept: The current version stays as it was last saved.
err.no_version: the server did not return the new version
del.title: Delete this version?
del.body: “{name}” ({from}) is deleted; recordings pinned to it go back to their streamer's versions. Recordings already scanned keep their events until they are detected again.
toast.reset: built-in boxes loaded - Save to keep them
toast.pin_save_first: save the version first: a pinned recording uses the saved zones
toast.pinned: recording #{id} pinned to “{name}” - re-detect it to apply
toast.redetect_save_first: save first: re-detect uses the saved zones
redet.title: Re-detect this streamer

redet.body_n_html.one: Queue detect again for the {count} recording of {name} ({provider}), ahead of the normal queue. Your keep / false-positive verdicts and notes carry over.
redet.body_n_html.other: Queue detect again for the {count} recordings of {name} ({provider}), ahead of the normal queue. Your keep / false-positive verdicts and notes carry over.

redet.body_all_html: Queue detect again for every probed recording of {name} ({provider}), ahead of the normal queue. Your keep / false-positive verdicts and notes carry over.
toast.no_templates: this streamer has no saved templates
imp.title: Import zone templates
imp.overwrite: Overwrite existing versions? A version already here (same streamer and date) is replaced with “Overwrite”, kept with “Keep mine”.
